description: Provides an icon action button with an accessible text label.

examples.label: Example 1
examples.code:
Activate the heart button to add a like.

Likes: 0

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: Color forwarded to the internal `<tp-icon>`.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Prevents activation, including link navigation, and marks the control as disabled.

attributes.name: download
attributes.description: Suggested download filename when href is set. A nonempty value requests a download; browser and server rules determine whether it is honored.

attributes.name: flip-h
attributes.description: Horizontal flip forwarded to the internal `<tp-icon>`.

attributes.name: flip-v
attributes.description: Vertical flip forwarded to the internal `<tp-icon>`.

attributes.name: href
attributes.description: Destination URL. A nonempty value renders a link instead of a native button.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible button name and hover title. Provide the action, such as Close or Search, because the control has no visible text label.

attributes.name: library
attributes.description: Icon registry used to resolve name, for example tp, components, languages or a custom registered library.

attributes.name: loading
attributes.description: Displays a loading spinner and prevents activation while present.

attributes.name: loading-mode
attributes.description: Spinner layout while loading: replace hides the label; inline keeps the label beside the spinner.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Identifier of the icon displayed inside the button, resolved in library.

attributes.name: outlined
attributes.description: Uses an outlined appearance instead of a filled background.

attributes.name: pill
attributes.description: Rounds the button ends to form a pill.

attributes.name: rel
attributes.description: Space-separated relationship tokens forwarded to the link, for example noopener noreferrer; applies only with href.

attributes.name: rotate
attributes.description: Rotation forwarded to the internal `<tp-icon>`.

attributes.name: scale
attributes.description: Scale forwarded to the internal `<tp-icon>`.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Button and icon size preset: xxs, xs, s, m, l, xl or xxl.

attributes.name: spin
attributes.description: Continuous spin forwarded to the internal `<tp-icon>`.

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: Image or SVG URL forwarded to the icon; takes precedence over name.

attributes.name: target
attributes.description: Browsing context for href, such as _self, _blank or a named frame; ignored in native button mode.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Controls the title.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Native button action: button, submit or reset; ignored when href is set.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: Color variant: neutral, brand, success, danger, warning or info.

methods.name: focus(): void
methods.description: Moves keyboard focus to the internal native button, when it exists.

events.name: click
events.description: Native click event bubbling from the inner button when activated by pointer or keyboard; disabled controls suppress activation. This is not a CustomEvent, so there is no custom detail payload.

cssproperties.name: --tp-icon-button-focus-ring
cssproperties.description: Color of the outline shown when the button receives keyboard focus.

cssproperties.name: --tp-icon-button-hover-background
cssproperties.description: Background color of the button on hover.

cssproperties.name: --tp-icon-button-icon-size
cssproperties.description: Width and height of the icon inside the button; distinct from the clickable area.

cssproperties.name: --tp-icon-button-radius
cssproperties.description: Corner radius of the clickable button.

cssproperties.name: --tp-icon-button-size
cssproperties.description: Minimum width and height of the clickable button; size presets also update this value.

dependencies.name: tp-base
dependencies.summary: Shared base class for tp-* components.

dependencies.name: tp-icon
dependencies.summary: SVG icon component with inline, URL, and registry sources.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-icon-button>` element provides an icon action button with an accessible text label.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Button | Click to perform the action identified by its label. Disabled or loading controls cannot be activated. |
| Navigation button | Click to open its destination. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> / <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd> | Move between the available controls. |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> | Activate the focused button or link. |
| <kbd>Space</kbd> | Activate a focused action button; links use <kbd>Enter</kbd>. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Choose a component from the hierarchy under the pointer, or around the focused component, then open its help. <kbd>Alt</kbd> is <kbd>Option</kbd> on macOS; include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |

keyboard.description: Uses native button activation; links activate with Enter.
